title: Asset Templates
description: Six pre-audited smart contract templates for African real-world assets.
---

## Overview

Ankara Chain ships six ERC-20 asset templates. Each is a UUPS upgradeable proxy deployed via the `TokenFactory`. All templates inherit `AnkaraChainBaseToken` — providing mint, burn, pause, role-based access control, and a pluggable identity verifier.

| Template | CLI value | Contract | Use Case |
|----------|-----------|----------|----------|
| [Farmland](/templates/farmland) | `farmland` | `FarmlandToken.sol` | Agricultural land tokenization |
| [Commodity Receipt](/templates/commodity) | `commodity` | `CommodityReceiptToken.sol` | Warehouse receipt financing |
| [Real Estate](/templates/real-estate) | `real-estate` | `RealEstateToken.sol` | Fractional property ownership |
| [Invoice](/templates/invoice) | `invoice` | `InvoiceToken.sol` | Trade finance / receivables |
| [Carbon Credit](/templates/carbon-credit) | `carbon-credit` | `CarbonCreditToken.sol` | Emissions credit tokenization |
| [Mining Rights](/templates/mining-rights) | `mining-rights` | `MiningRightsToken.sol` | Mineral license tokenization |

---

## Common Features (All Templates)

Every template provides:

- **ERC-20** fungible token with `mint`, `burn`, `transfer`
- **Pause / unpause** — halt transfers in emergencies
- **Role-based access control** — `MINTER_ROLE`, `PAUSER_ROLE`, `MANAGER_ROLE`, `UPGRADER_ROLE`
- **Asset lifecycle** — `DRAFT → ACTIVE → SUSPENDED → REDEEMED / EXPIRED`
- **Identity verifier hook** — plug in any `IIdentityVerifier` implementation to gate transfers
- **UUPS upgradeable** — fix bugs or add features without migrating token holders
- **On-chain metadata** — versioned, with `MetadataUpdated` events
- `assetId` — unique identifier (stored as `bytes32`, passed as a human-readable string that gets hashed)
- `countryCode` — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

---

## Asset Lifecycle

```
DRAFT (0)
  │
  ├─► ACTIVE (1)       ← Tokens can be minted and transferred
  │     │
  │     ├─► SUSPENDED (2)  ← Transfers paused, investigation
  │     │     │
  │     │     └─► ACTIVE   ← Resumed after resolution
  │     │
  │     ├─► REDEEMED (3)   ← Asset has been redeemed / settled
  │     │
  │     └─► EXPIRED (4)    ← Time-limited assets (commodity, mining, invoice)
```

Status is changed via `setStatus(uint8)` — requires `MANAGER_ROLE`.

---

## Identity Verifier

All templates support an optional `IIdentityVerifier` that gates mints and transfers:

```solidity
interface IIdentityVerifier {
    function isVerified(address account) external view returns (bool);
    function verifyIdentity(address account) external;
    function revokeIdentity(address account) external;
}
```

- Pass `identityVerifier` in deploy options to enable it
- Pass `address(0)` (or omit) for open / no KYC
- Use the built-in `WhitelistVerifier` for simple whitelist-based verification on testnet
- Swap the verifier at any time via `setIdentityVerifier(address)` without redeploying

---

## Roles

| Role | Hash | Default holder | Can do |
|------|------|---------------|--------|
| `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` | `0x00` | admin address | Grant / revoke all roles |
| `MINTER_ROLE` | `keccak256("MINTER_ROLE")` | admin | `mint()` |
| `PAUSER_ROLE` | `keccak256("PAUSER_ROLE")` | admin | `pause()` / `unpause()` |
| `MANAGER_ROLE` | `keccak256("MANAGER_ROLE")` | admin | `setStatus()`, `updateMetadata()`, template-specific writes |
| `UPGRADER_ROLE` | `keccak256("UPGRADER_ROLE")` | admin | `upgradeTo()` |

All roles default to the `admin` address provided at deploy time.
